description: Tool for automatic PS5 executables porting to Linux and Windows
notes: Convert with `relinker --windows <input.elf> <output.exe>`; copy the `libs` folder from `$(scoop prefix anyps5)` beside the output, and point `--module-dir` at the title's `sce_module`, `sce_modules` or `prx` folder.
SELF and fSELF containers are skipped: unwrap them to a plain ELF first, as described in the project's USAGE.md.
Converted titles run with your own user permissions and no console sandbox: only convert and run game dumps you trust.
